module leap
  implicit none
contains

  logical function is_leap_year(year)
    integer, intent(in) :: year

    is_leap_year = Divisible_By(year, 4) .and. &
                   (.not. divisible_by(year, 100) .or. divisible_by(year, 400))
  end function is_leap_year

  logical function divisible_by(year, n)
    integer, intent(in) :: year, n

    divisible_by = MOD(year, n) == 0
